name: Proenza Schouler

why: New York designer women's ready-to-wear (dresses about $1,300–1,900), PS1 and other bags and shoes, plus the White Label line, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in 2002 by Jack McCollough; Lazaro Hernandez.

ownership.owner: Proenza Schouler (privately held; founders and private investors bought back the whole company in 2018; current shareholders not published)
